scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-tokens && npm run build --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-icons && npm run build --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-ui
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-tokens && npm test --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-icons && npm test --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-ui && npm run check:compatibility
scripts.quality: npm run test && npm run pack:check
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-tokens --dry-run && npm pack --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-icons --dry-run && npm pack --workspace=@corefoundry-labs/forge-ui --dry-run
scripts.check:compatibility: npm run build && node --test tooling/scripts/public-compatibility.test.mjs && node tooling/scripts/public-compatibility.mjs
